name: CreateMetricRuleBlackList

parameters.help_en: The name of the blacklist policy
parameters.help_zh: 报警黑名单策略的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For more information about the namespaces of different cloud services, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云服务的数据命名空间。

关于云服务的命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The category of the cloud service. For example, ApsaraDB for Redis includes the following categories: ApsaraDB for Redis (standard architecture), ApsaraDB for Redis (cluster architecture), and ApsaraDB for Redis (read/write splitting architecture). In this case, the valid values of this parameter for ApsaraDB for Redis include `kvstore_standard`, `kvstore_sharding`, and `kvstore_splitrw`
parameters.help_zh: 云服务的类型分类。例如：Redis有`kvstore_standard`（标准版）、`kvstore_sharding`（集群版）和`kvstore_splitrw`（读写分离版）等
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope of the blacklist policy. Valid values:

USER (default): The blacklist policy takes effect only for the current Alibaba Cloud account.

GROUP: The blacklist policy takes effect only for the specified application group. For information about how to query the IDs of application groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的生效范围。取值：

USER（默认值）：报警黑名单策略仅在当前阿里云账号中生效。

GROUP：报警黑名单策略在指定应用分组中生效，您需要选择指定应用分组。
  关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group. The value of this parameter is a JSON array.

This parameter must be specified when `ScopeType` is set to `GROUP`
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID列表。格式为JSON Array。

仅当`ScopeType`为`GROUP`时，需要设置该参数
parameters.name: scope_value

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the blacklist policy starts to take effect.

Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略生效的开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒
parameters.name: enable_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the blacklist policy expires.

Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略生效的结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒
parameters.name: enable_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time range within which the blacklist policy is effective.

If you do not configure this parameter, the blacklist policy is permanently effective.

If you configure this parameter, the blacklist policy is effective only within the specified time range. Examples:

`03:00-04:59`: The blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 local time. 05:00 local time is excluded.

`03:00-04:59 UTC+0700`: The blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 (UTC+7). 05:00 (UTC+7) is excluded
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的生效时间范围。

如果您未设置该参数，则报警黑名单策略永久有效。

如果您已设置该参数，则黑名单策略仅在指定的时间范围内有效。该参数有以下两种格式示例：
    - `03:00-04:59`：本地时间凌晨3点到凌5点（不包含05:00）报警黑名单策略有效。
    - `03:00-04:59 UTC+0700`：东7区时间凌晨3点到凌晨5点（不包含05:00）报警黑名单策略有效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances that belong to the specified cloud service
parameters.help_zh: 报警黑名单策略中指定云服务的实例列表
parameters.name: instances

fields.help_en:
The metric name.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
监控指标名称。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: metric_name

fields.help_en:
The extended dimension of the instance. For example, `{"device":"C:"}` specifies that the blacklist policy is applied to all C disks of the specified Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
实例的扩展维度信息。例如：`{"device":"C:"}`，表示对云服务器ECS实例下的所有C盘应用黑名单策略。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The metrics of the instance.

If you do not configure this parameter, the blacklist policy applies to all metrics of the specified cloud service.

If you configure this parameter, the blacklist policy applies only to the current metric
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的监控指标。

如果您未设置该参数，则报警黑名单策略应用于指定云服务下的所有监控指标。

如果您已设置该参数，则黑名单策略仅应用于当前监控指标
parameters.name: metrics
